site_subtitle: Independent citizen tool for Uttar Pradesh
independent_banner: Independent citizen tool. Not a government website.
hero_title: Get your civic grievance heard in UP
hero_desc: Find your officer, generate a formal complaint, and track resolution.
step1_desc: Select the primary issue affecting your area to pre-fill standard grievance details.
step2_desc: Specify your area type and administrative boundary to identify the competent officer.
step3_desc: Review the resolved officer contact, add your details, preview your letter, and take action.
cat_road_default: The local road / brick paving (kharanja) is severely damaged with potholes and broken edges, obstructing daily commute and pedestrian movement.
cat_drainage_default: The drainage channel is choked and overflowing with wastewater, causing waterlogging on the street and creating serious public health hazards.
cat_water_default: The public drinking water handpump is dysfunctional and dry, leaving residents without access to safe drinking water.
cat_light_default: The street lights / public lights have been non-functional for an extended period, causing darkness and unsafe conditions at night.
cat_garbage_default: Garbage and waste have accumulated in public areas without regular collection, causing foul odor and unsanitary conditions.
cat_audit_default: Information and inspection are requested regarding sanctioned public development funds, ongoing works, and completed construction quality in this locality.

missing_step_2: 2. File this complaint online on the UP Jansunwai portal (jansunwai.up.nic.in).

timeline_day0_desc: Send email or hand-deliver printed letter. Ensure you obtain a physical diary receipt number or email delivery acknowledgment.
timeline_day7_desc: Call the designated officer's official CUG number during office hours (10:00 AM - 12:00 PM). Quote your diary receipt number and inquire about the inspection schedule.
timeline_day15_desc: If no inspection or action has occurred, present your receipt copy at your local Tehsil during Sampoorna Samadhan Diwas (held on designated Saturdays, check your tehsil schedule) to the SDM or CDO.
timeline_day30_desc: If still unresolved past the statutory 30-day timeframe under the UP Janhit Guarantee Act, submit a formal reminder on jansunwai.up.nic.in and file an RTI for the Action Taken Report (ATR).
faq_q1: Is this an official government website?
faq_a1: No. This is an independent, open citizen tool created to help residents of Uttar Pradesh draft formal complaint letters and identify local administrative contacts. We do not represent any government department.
faq_q2: What happens after I send this complaint letter?
faq_a2: Under the UP Janhit Guarantee Act, 2011, basic civic complaints carry a notified timeframe (typically 7 to 30 days). Always obtain a diary receipt number so you can track progress and escalate during Sampoorna Samadhan Diwas if needed.
faq_q3: Does this tool store my personal information?
faq_a3: No. All text generation and storage happen strictly inside your own browser (using localStorage on your device). Nothing is transmitted to external servers or third-party trackers.
faq_q4: What should I do if an officer's phone number is unreachable or outdated?
faq_a4: Click 'Report a wrong number' on the officer card to notify our maintenance repository, and verify alternative contacts directly on your district's official NIC portal ({district}.nic.in).
footer_disclaimer: This site helps you write letters. It is not run by or connected to the Government of Uttar Pradesh, and it cannot guarantee a response. Officer details can change, so confirm them before you rely on them.
